_meta.description: Glow recommendations.json — 3 undertones x 15 styles. Face shape and eye shape handled separately in placement/technique modules.

clean_girl.label: Clean Girl
clean_girl.description: Fresh, minimal, effortless skin-focused look with glowy skin and natural features.

no_makeup.label: No-Makeup Makeup
no_makeup.description: Barely-there coverage that perfects the skin while looking completely natural.

fresh_dewy.label: Fresh Dewy
fresh_dewy.description: Hydrated, glass-skin glow with soft color and a lit-from-within radiance.

soft_glam.label: Soft Glam
soft_glam.description: Polished and put-together with soft neutral tones and defined but not dramatic features.

korean_daily.label: Korean Daily
korean_daily.description: Youthful and fresh K-beauty inspired look with soft blush, BB cream, and lip tint.

peach_makeup.label: Peach Makeup
peach_makeup.description: Warm peachy monochromatic look with matching blush, eyeshadow, and lip gloss.

soft_contour.label: Soft Contour
soft_contour.description: Subtly sculpted face with soft blending, natural glow, and defined structure.

lifted_makeup.label: Lifted Makeup
lifted_makeup.description: Eye-lifting techniques with blush and highlight placement to create an uplifted effect.

snatched.label: Snatched
snatched.description: Full face with defined contour, bold highlight, and strong features for a sculpted look.

igari.label: Igari
igari.description: Japanese-style 'hangover blush' look with flushed cheeks and minimal eye makeup.

douyin.label: Douyin
douyin.description: Viral Chinese social media look with porcelain skin, straight brows, and puppy eyes.

strawberry.label: Strawberry Girl
strawberry.description: Rosy, berry-toned monochromatic look with flushed cheeks and glossy pink lips.

office.label: Office Makeup
office.description: Professional and polished with neutral tones, clean liner, and a structured finish.

neutral_glam.label: Neutral Glam
neutral_glam.description: Warm neutral tones taken to a glamorous level with defined contour and bold lip.

corporate_clean.label: Corporate Clean
corporate_clean.description: Minimal, clean, and professional — foundation finish with subtle features for the workplace.
